title: Set the Derivative Equal to Zero
text: At the minimum of this convex differentiable objective, set the derivative from the previous part equal to $$0$$.

title: Expand the Sum
text: After removing the nonzero constant factor, expand sum[x_i**2*(y_i-theta_1*x_i)] $$=$$ $$0$$.

title: Isolate $$\theta_1$$
text: Rearrange to $$\sum {x_i}^2 y_i$$ $$=$$ $$\theta_1 \sum {x_i}^3$$, then divide by $$\sum {x_i}^3$$.
